_description: Shared model registry for all AIXIA-workspace projects. Projects resolve model family → current_version at runtime from this file. Maintained by the bi-weekly model-release crawler (scheduled trigger). See ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md §9.5 for policy.
_bootstrap_note: This is the bootstrap state from 2026-04-20. Entries marked bootstrap_unverified: true are seeded from CLAUDE Code context and should be verified on the first crawler run. Pricing drifts; registry values are authoritative — always re-read at call-time.

claude_opus.notes: UPDATED Jul 27, 2026: claude-opus-4-8 → claude-opus-5 (released July 24, 2026). Pricing unchanged: $5/$25 per million tokens — same cost as Opus 4.8, at significantly higher capability. Anthropic positions it as 'close to Fable 5 intelligence at half Fable 5's price.' Benchmarks: SWE-bench Verified 96.0% (up from 69.2%), SWE-bench Pro 79.2%, FrontierBench v0.1 43.3% at max effort. Leads the field on Anthropic's agentic-coding eval (ahead of Fable 5's 33.7% and GPT-5.6 Sol's 34.4%). 1M context window (default and max), 128K output tokens. New default on Claude Max plan. Fast Mode remains available at $10/$50 per million. Available on Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI. Predecessor claude-opus-4-8 no longer listed as current; projects should migrate to claude-opus-5. Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change.

claude_fable.notes: Verified Aug 10, 2026; no change. 🟢 API remains restored (was suspended June 12–July 1, 19 days). Context: US government export-control directive lifted after Anthropic added cybersecurity classifier and widened safety margin. Backstory on suspension preserved for audit trail.

gemini_flash.notes: UPDATED Jul 27, 2026: gemini-3.5-flash → gemini-3.6-flash (released July 21, 2026). Output pricing reduced: $9.00 → $7.50 per million tokens (~17% reduction). routing_defaults.description: Canonical default routing for common task categories. Projects override as needed in their local CLAUDE.md.

privacy_mode_routing.description: When a project/tier enables Privacy Mode, all calls route through Claude only (no DeepSeek, no third-party-jurisdiction routes). Studio-tier Echoform users default to Privacy Mode.
